sections.text: Run locally with Ollama (ollama run llama3.2, then an OpenAI-compatible API at localhost:11434), LM Studio or llama.cpp; serve at scale with vLLM, TGI or SGLang.

sections.heading: API vs self-hosting
sections.text: Small hosted models are often cheaper than self-hosting until volumes are very large; self-hosting wins on strict data residency, offline/edge needs, or very high steady volume.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Climb the ladder: prompt → examples → RAG → tools → fine-tuning; use RAG for knowledge and fine-tuning for behaviour.

sections.heading: Contents
sections.text: Read this first: what is verified and what is not

sections.heading: Read this first: what is verified and what is not
sections.text: Product lineups change every few months. Model names, plan names and limits in this guide are the names known when it was written.

sections.heading: Chapter 1: How large language models work
1.1 What a large language model is [Fact]
sections.text: A large language model (LLM) is a program trained on very large amounts of text to predict the next piece of text.

sections.heading: 1.2 Training and inference [Fact]
sections.text: Training is the one-off, expensive process that sets the parameters from data.

sections.heading: 1.3 Tokens [Fact]
sections.text: A token is a piece of text the model reads or writes: a whole word, part of a word, a number fragment or punctuation.

sections.heading: 1.4 Context window and context [Fact]
sections.text: The context is everything the model can see when it answers: your message, the earlier conversation, any uploaded documents, and any hidden instructions the product adds.

sections.heading: 1.5 Parameters, weights and model size [Fact]
sections.text: Parameters are the learned values inside the model.

sections.heading: 1.6 Reasoning models [Fact]
sections.text: Some models spend extra output on working through a problem before they give the final answer.

sections.heading: 1.7 Multimodal models [Fact]
sections.text: A multimodal model accepts more than text: images, documents, sometimes audio and video, and sometimes produces images.
